text_block_list.text:
During a hospital visit, Marvelous Sunday 
met a boy who was feeling down because an 
injury prevented him from playing soccer.

She encourages the boy, telling him that 
Fuji Kiseki's hard work in her races holds 
the same value as his own efforts to keep 
training while battling his injuries.

The future can be changed by who you are 
right now. Moved by Marvelous Sunday's 
words, the young boy resolved not to give 
up.

Marvelous Sunday says she's looking 
forward to racing Fuji Kiseki. Seeing this 
makes you want to grant Fuji Kiseki's 
dream all over again.
